description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are proud to present this superb, four-bedroom, semi-detached family home ideally situated in this highly sought-after development off the Hole in the Wall Road in Donagahmede, Dublin 13.

 

Perfectly positioned just off Hole in the Wall Road, Grattan Lodge boasts a prime location with seamless access to the M50, M1, and Dublin Airport. The area is well-serviced by public transport, including a 24-hour No. 15 bus route to the city centre and Clongriffin Dart Station just a 10-minute walk away. A host of amenities are within close reach, including local schools, and shopping options such as Clarehall and Donaghmede Shopping Centres. There are also several well-regarded creches within walking distance, including Learning Circle, Little Rainbow, Giraffe and Tiger, making this an ideal location for young families.

 

Bright and spacious internal living accommodation of c. 110 sqm comprises inviting entrance hallway with downstairs WC and storage closet, large living room with feature fireplace, fully fitted kitchen and dining room with access to a large westerly facing rear garden. Upstairs host 4 generous bedrooms with built in wardrobes, master with ensuite and private balcony and a large family bathroom. No. 140 comes to the market in turn key condition and benefits gas fired central heating, quality flooring throughout, well proportion rooms, front driveway with off street parking, gated side entrance and a large Westerly facing rear garden. An opportunity not to be missed; Contact the agent at our Northside office on 01-6995050 or 086-0469458 for further information or to arrange viewing!!
